page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 49 at the right. Main text in one column. Left margin holds a bracketed note "Nom.gen.mulieb.adiect.sin.num.definut in" beside a brace grouping examples. Two diagrams with braces below the text.

main_text.p: At in, O, quum definunt, virilis sunt generis: atq; Orécchia, & Fóglia infrequenti sunt vsu, sicut Cérchio, Chióstro, & Gélso: cætera vero non item.
Nom.gen.mulieb.adiect.sin.num.definut inA, Bianca, Bella, Diuina, Ornata, Fiera, Rea, &c. E, Fedele, Crudele, Forte : quæ & viril. gen. sunt.

Cæterùm in multitudinis numero huiusmodi nomina habebūt, I, postremo loco, si in sing. habebunt, E: quòd si in sin. habebunt, A, in plur. habebūt, E. ¶Hinc fit, vt quæ habent in sing. duplicem finem, eundem habeant quoque duplicè in plurali numero: id quod typis ostendere non pigebit.
main_text.l: Num. sing. A, Stella; E, Fonte — Num. plu. E, Stelle; I, Fonti.
Num. sin. A, A'rma; E, A'rme — Num. plu. E, A'rme; I, A'rmi.

page.notes: Marginal bracket and brace notes at left; diagram text partly faint. Some words uncertain in the diagrams (e.g. "A'rme" in the second diagram is smudged).
